paragraphs: Ojuvi, 1984'ten beri çok uluslu şirketlere hizmet veren Empas Grubu'nun bir şirketi olan M3 Cosmetics tarafından 2014'te bir dünya markası yaratma vizyonuyla kuruldu.
Kısa sürede parfüm, kolonya ve esans üretimine başlayan marka; Avrupa, Asya ve Afrika'ya ihracat yapıyor, kendi mağazalarını açıyor ve distribütörlük veriyor.
Üretim uluslararası IFRA standartlarında; GMP ISO 22716, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 ve OHSAS 18001 sertifikalarıyla.
timeline: En İyi Niş Parfüm: Ojuvi Gold

en.lead: A vision to create a world brand.
paragraphs: Ojuvi was founded in 2014 by M3 Cosmetics, a company of Empas Group, which has served multinational companies since 1984, with the vision of creating a world brand.
In a short time it began producing perfumes, colognes and essences, exporting to Europe, Asia and Africa, opening its own stores and appointing distributors.
Production follows international IFRA standards, with GMP ISO 22716, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001 certificates.
timeline: Exports to Europe, Asia and Africa

en: It was named Best Niche Perfume at the Marie Claire Türkiye Fragrance Awards 2026.
What is in the Premium Plus series?
A 100 ml extrait de parfum with a 10 ml travel spray.
Where can I try the scents?
At the showrooms in the CVK and The Marmara hotels in Istanbul, and in South Africa.
